message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after firing by accelerating through a sustained descending right break, then holding an easterly separation line, given its outbound missile, the southbound opposing formation, and two opposing missiles advancing through the head-on exchange.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to maintain offensive pressure and forward engagement geometry by accelerating northward on a shallow rightward, descending course, given the opponents’ continuing southbound closure and its own missile running ahead; unlike A0100, it does not substantially leave the closing axis."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after firing by accelerating through a sustained descending right break, then holding an easterly separation line, given its outbound missile, the southbound opposing formation, and two opposing missiles advancing through the head-on exchange.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to maintain offensive pressure and forward engagement geometry by accelerating northward on a shallow rightward, descending course, given the opponents’ continuing southbound closure and its own missile running ahead; unlike A0100, it does not substantially leave the closing axis.
